title: UIU Vision and Mission
text: UIU's vision is to become a center of excellence in teaching, learning and research in the South Asian region. Its mission is to create excellent human resources with intellectual, creative, technical, moral and practical skills to serve the community, industry and region.

title: UIU Student Clubs
text: The official UIU CIAC student-clubs page lists clubs including UIU Debate Club, UIU Cultural Club, UIU Theater and Film Club, UIU Business Club, UIU Computer Club, UIU Electrical and Electronic Club, UIU Photography Club, UIU Social Services Club, UIU Sports Club, UIU MBA Club, UIU Robotics Club, and UIU Model United Nations Club. Check the official source for the current list and details.

title: UIU Mental Health and Psychological Counselling Center
text: UIU has a Mental Health and Psychological Counselling Center. According to its official website, counselling provides a confidential space to discuss emotional, psychological, and academic challenges. The website lists counsellor profiles and appointment information. Check the official website for current counsellor details, room information, and appointment availability.

title: UIU Undergraduate Programs
text: United International University (UIU) lists undergraduate programs under four schools. The School of Business and Economics includes Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA), BBA in Accounting and Information Systems (BBA in AIS), and Bachelor of Science in Economics. The School of Science and Engineering includes Civil Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), Data Science, and Electrical and Electronic Engineering (EEE). The School of Humanities and Social Sciences includes Environment and Development Studies, Media Studies and Journalism, and English. The School of Life Sciences includes Pharmacy and Biotechnology and Genetic Engineering. Consult the official UIU page for the current program list and admission details.

title: UIU Student Welfare and Support Services
text: The UIU student welfare information page describes support provided through the Career Counseling Center (CCC) and the Directorate of Student Affairs (DSA). The Career Counseling Center supports career skills development, internship placement, job search and placement, workshops, seminars, training, company visits, and on-campus interviews. The Directorate of Student Affairs supports co-curricular and extra-curricular activities, counselling service, loan facility, scholarships, gymnasium, games room, and female common room. For current availability and details, consult the official UIU source.
